label: #3594809: Use standard checkboxes on forms that require submission, pinned core
description: Compare ordinary checkboxes on the Core Appearance settings form. Before uses the Default Admin toggle-switch stylesheet; After applies MR !16770 so the same native checkbox controls use the shared checkbox styling.
status: draft: imported MR patch preserved; pinned comparison applies, latest comparison needs a separate rebase

steps.text: Use a Standard install with Default Admin as the administration theme.
Open /admin/appearance/settings in both frames and find the Page element display controls.
In each frame, inspect the Shortcut icon checkbox in its checked and unchecked states.
steps.lookFor: Before looks like a toggle switch. After looks like an ordinary square checkbox while remaining a native checkbox.

steps.text: Change the checkbox and leave the page without saving, then return and check the persisted value.
steps.lookFor: The pending form value is not persisted until Save configuration is activated.

steps.text: Change the checkbox again, use Save configuration, and reload the page.
steps.lookFor: The value persists after submission. The MR should change presentation, not form behavior.

expected: Native checkboxes on submission-based forms use the shared square checkbox presentation. Their values still change only after the form is submitted.
actual: Not run in a browser. Static source analysis shows that Before loads the toggle stylesheet and the After stack removes it; live presentation, semantics, and save behavior remain unverified.

checks.label: The Appearance settings form and Shortcut icon checkbox are present
Shortcut icon remains a native checkbox
The Shortcut icon control uses the shared square checkbox width
The checkbox keeps its associated label
The form still requires Save configuration

observe.label: Shortcut icon is visually a switch
Shortcut icon is visually a standard checkbox with a clear checked state
Changing the checkbox alone does not persist the setting
Saving the form persists the selected value

coverage.note: The combinations that count as tested for this issue (scripts/coverage.mjs). Edit to fit the question the issue asks.
manual: Keyboard Tab and Space interaction with visible focus
Pointer activation through the checkbox and its associated label
Forced-colors light and dark palettes, recorded as browser emulation rather than native Windows contrast themes
Real VoiceOver or NVDA testing is not performed unless requested
Zoom to 200 and 400 percent and reflow at 320 CSS pixels
RTL layout, long labels, validation-error styling, and disabled controls
